Name: Pack File List
Description: Packs all files in the file list

Name: Delete Cubemaps
Description: Deletes all .vtf files in the map

Name: Repack
Description: Decompresses map if -compress is not passed

Name: Threads
Description: Number of threads used for LZMA compression. Higher values repack large maps faster.

Name: Verbose
Description: Prints detailed information about each file as it is packed.

Name: Insert Search Path
Description: Add an extra search path in front of the ones from gameinfo.txt, so its content wins over the game's. Several paths can be given separated by commas.

Name: Append Search Path
Description: Add an extra search path behind the ones from gameinfo.txt, for content the game does not already have. Several paths can be given separated by commas.
